rv.q: I think BET likely has a potentially long-running hit here, given the reaction from the audience which danced, sang along, cheered and grooved.
It must’ve been a daunting task for Daryl D. Brooks, BET playwright and director, to decide which of the multitude of great songs and performers from the ’80’s to include in this retrospective revue.
Harris and Lewis were outstanding, and their chemistry and wit made this musical a must-see.
The Time Machine: A Tribute to the 80's is more than just a musical revue; it's a time capsule capturing the raw energy, cultural impact, and enduring legacy of 80s music.
Fun, uplifting, nostalgic… 'Time Machine: A Tribute to the Eighties' is a celebration of Black music excellence that leaves you feeling good from head to toe.
Regardless of your age, go out and immediately buy tickets to see this exemplary and uplifting production! You will enjoy yourself immensely!
